_note: manifest.json (JSON, not YAML) — PowerShell has no built-in YAML parser. Identical structure to NEWSFEED_ARCHITECTURE.md spec.

crons.name: 5 Minute Status
crons.description: Reads MT5 EA log and TradingView Pine tables. Writes one-line status summary to newsfeed. Requires active Claude session (TradingView MCP).

crons.name: Trading Analysis
crons.description: Claude reads recent newsfeed + live charts. Identifies structural drift, slippage patterns, stale alerts. Writes findings.

crons.name: Alert Health
crons.description: Checks Pine alert count from TV table. Flags ALERT_DOWN if count is 0.

crons.name: Claude UHV Agent (paper — superseded by claude_trader)
crons.description: DISABLED — paper trading (0.01 lots). Superseded by claude_trader which trades live at 0.40 lots.

crons.name: Claude Trader v1
crons.description: Claude independently analyses raw OHLCV candles for UHV breakout. Executes LIVE trades at 0.40 lots via PineConnector (comment=Claude_Trader_v1). Dashboard at http://localhost:3457.

crons.name: Daily Scorecard
crons.description: Reads last 7 days of archive + turtle_fills.csv. Computes per-cron usefulness scores and trading stats. Pure PowerShell, no Claude needed.

crons.name: Health Check
crons.description: Checks TV/MT5 process status, fills CSV freshness, cron overdue, inbox overflow. Pure PowerShell, runs 24/7 via Task Scheduler.
